read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table and decision log
input: Peak 3-second gust at 10 m in open terrain (mph), 50 to 250 mph; the building's terrain class picks the curve
out_of_scope: Contents (declared as a withheld placeholder part)
Storm surge and rain flooding (flood cell)
missing_mechanisms: Tree fall on the house (a separate Hazus add-on, withheld)
Tornadoes spawned by the hurricane (convective cell)

how_to_use.share_of: Structure replacement cost new of the same building

outputs.single_event: conditional: proposal, not in the runtime index; building and terrain class required
outputs.scenario_dollars: withheld until the building value is qualified
outputs.yearly_loss: withheld before promotion (computed by the consumer afterwards)

conditions: hazus_terrain_class is required (open, light suburban, suburban, light trees, trees); never defaulted and never also applied to the gust
Below 50 mph returns 0; above 250 mph withholds
Only the reference wind characteristics of each building are published; other values withhold

method.summary: FEMA Hazus hurricane building-loss rows used as published (every 5 mph, five terrain classes) for the Hazus building type and wind characteristics matching each building; the 32 Hazus curves used are identical in FEMA's 6.1 extract and SimCenter's independent 5.1 copy

key_sources: FEMA, Hazus 7.0 Hurricane Model Technical Manual (2025) (TCRE-S001)
FEMA Hazus 6.1 hurricane damage and loss function extract (TCRE-S002)
NHERI SimCenter, Hazus 5.1 hurricane loss functions, independent copy (TCRE-S003)
judgment: Wind characteristics the profiles don't state are set to the national most-common Hazus values (e.g. house roof connections)
No value per area set, so scenario dollars stay withheld
open_items: A building-code or design-wind zone per cell would let the house use code-built connections (19.0% instead of 31.3% at 120 mph, open terrain)
Hazus commercial rows read higher in light-suburban than open terrain (office 17.4% vs 14.0% at 120 mph; kept as published)
No outside loss check yet (no claims or NRI comparison)
